english.text: AU rules say the winning candidate must obtain two thirds of member states’ votes. Nmehielle explained that if no one wins this majority in the first round, the candidate with least votes will be knocked out and a second round held.

english.text: Moreover, if Helenus has any foresight, if the seer may claim any faith, if Apollo fills his soul with truths, this one thing, Goddess-born, this one in lieu of all I will foretell, and again and again repeat the warning: mighty Juno’s power honour first with prayer; to Juno joyfully chant vows, and win over the mighty mistress with suppliant gifts. So at last you will leave Trinacria behind and be sped triumphantly to the bounds of Italy.

english.text: In the morning of the 3rd of March of 2022, at the cafe, I had barbecue potato chips, a cinnamon coffee cake, and iced black tea. I saw an ex-barista, the Mexican Lizbeth, who now teaches dancing. I thought that she had moved out of Lulu Island, as I had not seen her for a long time. Max, a Chinese barista, in green, sat at my table, as she did her psychology homework on her laptop before her shift started. Later in the morning after eleven o'clock, I returned to the mall, to the pizzeria, for a pesto cheese pizza slice and iced tea.

text: 喺2022年3月3號嘅朝早，喺咖啡館，我食咗個燒烤薯片、一個肉桂咖啡蛋糕同冰紅茶，我見到一個前咖啡師，墨西哥人莉茲貝斯，佢而家教緊跳舞，我以為佢搬咗出露露島，因為我好耐冇見過佢。一個着住綠色衫嘅中國咖啡師 Max 坐喺我張枱度，佢喺佢班次開始之前用手提電腦做緊佢嘅心理學功課。朝早十一點幾，我返咗去商場，去薄餅鋪，食咗個香蒜芝士薄餅片同冰茶。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Back in 2002 and several years thereafter, I regularly attended meditation sessions at Wat Yanviriya Buddhist Temple in East Vancouver, BC. I came to know the Thai culture more because of it. Pāli chanting, moon festivals, relics viewing, et cetera were part of my life then. I remember a spacious hall with hardwood floors and a Buddha altar in front. In summers, the doors would be open to the sunny green outside. In the wetter seasons at night, candles would be lit in the silent darkness inside. (I wore a black Australian Outback jacket then.) Omnipresent was the Ajahn Bhoontam in orange robe, he conducting the rituals. Our saṅgha or congregation was medium-sized and multiethnic. A real saṅgha full of Thais allowed us to share the rustic building. The two groups met at different times.

jyutping: faan2 dou3 2002 nin4 tung4 zi1 hau6 gei2 nin4，ngo5 ding6 kei4 caam1 gaa1 hai2 bei1 si1 saang2 dung1 wan1 go1 waa4 ge3 Wat Yanviriya fat6 zi2 ge3 ming5 soeng2 wui5，jan1 wai6 keoi5 gang3 gaa1 jing6 sik1 taai3 gwok3 man4 faa3，jan1 wai6 dong1 si4 ngo5 ge3 sang1 wut6 jap6 min6，jau5 jat1 go3 fun1 cong2 ge3 daai6 tong4，jau5 ngaang6 muk6 dei6 baan2，cin4 min6 jau5 jat1 go3 luk6 sik1 ge3 fat6 taan4。hai2 je6 maan5 ciu4 sap1 ge3 gwai3 zit3，hai2 jap6 min6 ge3 zik6 zing6 haak1 am3 zung1 wui5 dim2 jin4 laap6 zuk1（dong1 si4 ngo5 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 hak1 sik1 ge3 ou3 zau1 Outback ngoi6 tou3。）mou4 cyu3 bat1 zoi6 ge3 hai6 san1 cyun1 caang2 sik1 coeng4 pou4 ge3 Ajahn Bhoontam ，keoi5 zyu2 ci4 ji4 sik1。ngo5 dei6 ge3 zang1 leoi5 waak6 ze2 wui5 zung3 hai6 zung1 jing4 tung4 do1 zuk6 jeoi6。jat1 go3 cung1 mun5 taai3 gwok3 jan4 ge3 zan1 zing3 sing3 tong2 ling6 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 fan1 hoeng2 ni1 go3 hoeng1 cyun1 gin3 zuk1 mat6。
text: 返到2002年同之後幾年，我定期參加喺卑詩省東溫哥華嘅 Wat Yanviriya 佛寺嘅冥想會，因為佢更加認識泰國文化，因為當時我嘅生活入面，有一個寬敞嘅大堂，有硬木地板，前面有一個綠色嘅佛壇。喺夜晚潮濕嘅季節，喺入面嘅寂靜黑暗中會點燃蠟燭（當時我着住件黑色嘅澳洲 Outback 外套。）無處不在嘅係身穿橙色長袍嘅 Ajahn Bhoontam ，佢主持儀式。我哋嘅僧侶或者會眾係中型同多族裔。一個充滿泰國人嘅真正聖堂令我哋可以分享呢個鄉村建築物。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is the 15th of March of 2015, at a pizzeria on Lulu Island. Adil the Kazakh and I discuss the multilingual and multicultural landscape of South Asia, centuries ago, when there were many kingdoms in the region. Farsi was an elitist language, he says. His Kazakh is a Turkic language in Central Asia. I dutifully and gleefully inform him about PIE, Proto-Indo-European, the ancestral language of many Caucasoids today. The origin in theory is Southern Russia near the Black Sea, more than 6000 years ago. PIE was the great-great-grandfather of languages like Spanish, English, German, Welsh, Hindi, Greek, and many others today. Adil and I discuss about some modern humans who have genes from other species, like the Neanderthals and Denisovans. Scientists know that the brain size of the Neanderthal was bigger than the modern human's.

jyutping: 2015 nin4 3 jyut6 15 hou6，hai2 haa1 saat3 hak1 jan4 aa3 dik6 ji5 hai2 lou5 lou5 dou2 ge3 jat1 gaan1 bok6 beng2 pou2 dou6，ngo5 tung4 keoi5 tou2 leon6 zo2 gei2 sai3 gei2 cin4，dong1 si4 ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 jau5 hou2 do1 wong4 gwok3 ge3 jyu5 jin4，keoi5 waa6 keoi5 ge3 haa1 saat3 hak1 man4 hai6 jat1 zung2 hai2 zung1 aa3 ge3 dat6 kyut3 jyu5 jin4 gam1 jat6 hou2 do1 gou1 gaa1 sok3 jan4 ge3 jyu5 jin4，lei5 leon6 soeng6 hai6 hai2 haak1 hoi2 fu6 gan6 ge3 ngo4 lo4 si1 naam4 bou6，ciu1 gwo3 6000 nin4 cin4， PIE hai6 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 man2、jing1 man2、dak1 man2、wai1 ji5 si6 man4、jan3 dei6 man2、hei1 laap6 man4 tung4 hou3 do1 kei4 taa1 jyu5 jin4 ge3 cang4 zou2，ngo5 tung4 aa3 dik6 ji5 tou2 leon6 zo2 jat1 di1 jin6 doi6 jan4 leoi6，keoi5 dei6 ge3 gei1 jan1 hai6 lai4 zi6 kei4 taa1 mat6 zung2，lai6 jyu4 nei4 on1 dak1 laai1 jan4 tung4 jin6 doi6 jan4 jan4 leoi6 ge3。
text: 2015 年 3 月 15 號，喺哈薩克人阿迪爾喺魯魯島嘅一間薄餅舖度，我同佢討論咗幾世紀前，當時呢個地區有好多王國嘅語言，佢話佢嘅哈薩克文係一種喺中亞嘅突厥語言今日好多高加索人嘅語言，理論上係喺黑海附近嘅俄羅斯南部，超過6000年前， PIE 係西班牙文、英文、德文、威爾士文、印地文、希臘文同好多其他語言嘅曾祖，我同阿迪爾討論咗一啲現代人類，佢哋嘅基因係嚟自其他物種，例如尼安德拉人同現代人人類嘅。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: There was one thing in the case which had made the deepest impression both upon the servants and the police. This was the contortion of the Colonel's face. It had set, according to their account, into the most dreadful expression of fear and horror which a human countenance is capable of assuming. More than one person fainted at the mere sight of him, so terrible was the effect.

jyutping: ne1 daan1 on3 jap6 min6，jau5 jat1 joeng6 je5 ling6 buk6 jan4 tung4 ging2 fong1 dou1 jan3 zoeng6 zeoi3 sam1 hak1，zau6 hai6 soeng6 gaau3 ge3 min6 jung4 nau2 kuk1。geoi3 keoi5 dei6 miu4 seot6，keoi5 ge3 lim5 ding6 jing4 zo2，bin3 sing4 jan4 leoi6 min6 jung4 so2 nang4 biu2 jin6 ceot1 zeoi3 ho2 paa3 ge3 hung2 geoi6 tung4 ging1 haai5 biu2 cing4。hou2 do1 jan4 daan1 daan1 mong6 dou3 keoi5，zau6 ji5 ging1 wan4 dou2，jan1 wai6 go2 zung2 hung2 bou3 ge3 haau6 gwo2 sat6 zoi6 taai3 haai5 jan4。
text: 呢單案入面，有一樣嘢令僕人同警方都印象最深刻，就係上校嘅面容扭曲。據佢哋描述，佢嘅臉定型咗，變成人類面容所能表現出最可怕嘅恐懼同驚駭表情。好多人單單望到佢，就已經暈倒，因為嗰種恐怖嘅效果實在太駭人。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "Then wars shall cease and savage times grow mild, / and Remus and Quirinus, brethren twain, / with hoary Faith and Vesta undefiled, / shall give the law. With iron bolt and chain / firm-closed the gates of Janus shall remain. / Within, the Fiend of Discord, high reclined / on horrid arms, unheeded in the fane, / bound with a hundred brazen knots behind, / and grim with gory jaws, his grisly teeth shall grind."

text: 「戰爭將會終止，野蠻時代變得溫和，雷穆斯同奎里努斯，呢對兄弟，連同埋白髮蒼蒼嘅信義同純潔無瑕嘅維斯塔，將會頒布法則。雅努斯神廟嘅大門，會用鐵閂同鎖鏈牢牢關閉。廟內，紛爭惡魔高踞喺可怕嘅兵器之上，冇人理會，喺神殿深處畀一百條銅鏈從後綁住，血盆大口噉猙獰，磨緊佢可怕嘅牙齒。」
